statuses.LOCAL_PREFLIGHT_PASS: Exact reviewed local boundaries, inventories, hashes, source provenance and nearest project ancestor match. No remote validation or submission.
statuses.LOCAL_REFERENCE_PASS: Scripted miniature feature and workflow checks pass using mutable local state. Not independent model evidence.
statuses.WORKFLOW_PASS_ACCEPTANCE_PENDING: Legacy real-source workflow-only status. Not emitted by supported miniature setup; independent feature acceptance would remain required.
statuses.FAIL: An applicable check failed or an unsupported/policy event was recorded. Missing check keys are not passes.

exit_codes.0: Successful command or applicable local pass.
exit_codes.1: Preflight/audit failure; also used by normal child-command failures.
exit_codes.2: Argument parsing error or Git exact-branch no-match with --exit-code; inspect the operation.

scope: Fixed claims apply to the supplied scripts and deterministic tests, not arbitrary shell commands entered by a user.
